image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a reusable cloth diaper (nappy). The main body is made of a soft, white, fleece-like material. It features blue patterned fabric trim along the top waistband and side edges. There are visible elasticized gathers at the leg openings, creating ruffles. A small red and black tag or label is visible on the left side. Yellow snap buttons or fasteners are partially visible on the sides.
